title: phormium ramosum
intro: Phormium ramosum, commonly known as New Zealand flax, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Asphodelaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Phormium ramosum include soothing skin irritations, wound healing, and reducing inflammation.
